projects.name: BroxStudies
projects.summary: Turning study materials into focused practice.
projects.problem: Students preparing for exams need ways to practise with the syllabi, textbooks and past questions they already have.
projects.contribution: My work brings together a React study interface and a Python API for document processing and question generation.
projects.built: PDF uploads, subject-based practice, different question formats and difficulty levels, with asynchronous document processing.
projects.decision: The documented retrieval pipeline uses LangChain and FAISS to find relevant material before generating questions. FastAPI separates that processing from the React and TypeScript interface.
projects.outcome: A publicly accessible learning platform with source code available. Learning gains and adoption figures are not measured here.
projects.caption: Public homepage, captured September 2026.

projects.name: DCLM Church Manager
projects.summary: A shared place for the work behind a church community.
projects.problem: Church administration brings together attendance, membership records, offerings, budgets and recurring reports.
projects.contribution: I built a Flask application that puts these administrative tasks into one dashboard and a set of focused workflows.
projects.built: Member and attendance screens, contribution and offering records, budgets, and monthly reporting.
projects.decision: Server-rendered templates keep the interface close to the Python application. Separate models and routes organise the records and the workflows around them.
projects.outcome: The repository contains the application and reporting screens. The existing screenshot shows its dashboard; current organisational usage has not been independently confirmed.
projects.image_alt: DCLM church dashboard showing attendance, offerings and monthly summaries with zero values
projects.caption: Existing project screenshot · dashboard with empty records.

projects.name: Job Match Ghana
projects.summary: Exploring how local opportunities can be easier to find.
projects.problem: A useful job search needs to consider where someone lives, what they can do, and the salary they need.
projects.contribution: I built the Streamlit interface, preference filters, location-based ranking and downloadable matching report.
projects.built: Skill and region filtering, salary preferences, town and distance scoring, and PDF report generation.
projects.decision: The matching logic uses explicit filters and distance scores rather than an opaque prediction model. Pandas handles the tabular data; ReportLab creates the take-away report.
projects.outcome: A working-code prototype using generated example vacancies. It demonstrates the matching workflow, not a verified recruitment service or job-placement outcome.
